create_loader_parent: create a LoaderParent subclass that implements load_one_batch and num_instances for batch data loading
run_compute_idf_features: run compute_idf_features to compute IDF scores based on user and assistant utterances from raw data
run_compute_tf_features: run compute_tf_features to compute TF features for utterances using precomputed IDF scores
run_ship_torch_batch: run _ship_torch_batch to convert numpy arrays in a batch dictionary to PyTorch tensors on GPU
run_numpy_static: run the static numpy method to convert a batch of PyTorch tensors back to numpy arrays
